title: Titan The Robot! 4th August
headings: Get ready for an unforgettable day of futuristic fun as Titan the Robot arrives at Woodlands Family Theme Park on Tuesday, 4th August!
Titan shows are included with standard admission tickets.
contentHtml:
Get ready for an unforgettable day of futuristic fun as Titan the Robot arrives at Woodlands Family Theme Park on Tuesday, 4th August!

Blending comedy, street theatre, music and incredible special effects, Titan delivers a one-of-a-kind interactive show that has wowed audiences around the world. He’s appeared on hit TV shows including Big Brother, Daybreak and The Gadget Show, and starred at prestigious events such as the Abu Dhabi F1 Grand Prix, as well as the UK premieres of iRobot and Real Steel.

Catch Titan in action at intervals throughout the day and enjoy a full day of family adventure at Woodlands — featuring thrilling rides, exciting attractions, indoor soft play, and our popular zoo farm. Don’t miss this spectacular robotic experience!

Titan shows are included with standard admission tickets.

Book Park Tickets Here

Appearances will be at intervals throughout the day.

For any enquiries, please email fun@woodlandspark.com or message us on social media.
